top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a new class of quantum matter through a complete chain: Kane and Mele's quantum spin Hall prediction and Z2 classification, then Molenkamp's HgTe edge-transport observation, confirmed for fifteen to twenty years by transport, ARPES, STM and imaging. It is the most mature of the serious candidates, and its main weakness, the omitted Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and 3D contributors, is a limit on citation wording (2D prediction plus first realisation) and not a doubt about the discovery. P002 is second for its clean two-name credit and settled reproducibility, but it is a precision advance in an established technique with overlap with the 2005 and 2012 prizes; P003 is third because its pairing mechanism is unresolved and the experiments are only about eight years old, although its allocation is now cleaner. Any award is preferred to P000.
recusal_note: No recusal issue apparent from profile for P001: none of Kane, Mele or Molenkamp is among my documented connections. I share a Chalmers affiliation with Olsson, a colleague link and not a stake; my Chalmers and WACQT ties to superconducting-circuit work are not relevant to P001, P002 or P003.
